summary: Retested iteration_293 fixes for primary invoice template and DocumentPrint. Frontend print/PDF paths are now aligned with iframe/template-only behavior, but backend /use still strips ITEMS_ROWS placeholder entirely, leaving tbody empty and preventing row injection.

critical.issue: ITEMS_ROWS placeholder is missing in returned HTML (neither {{ITEMS_ROWS}} nor <!--{{ITEMS_ROWS}}--> exists), resulting in <tbody></tbody> and breaking row rendering contract.

integration_issues.issue: Renderer cannot inject rows when backend /use content has no ITEMS_ROWS placeholder; resolved sheet shows tbody row count 0 despite filled items.

action_items: Backend: preserve ITEMS_ROWS token in /use output within <tbody> for primary-mobile-a4-invoice-v1. If sanitizer is used, do not strip comment placeholders needed by renderer.
Keep either {{ITEMS_ROWS}} or <!--{{ITEMS_ROWS}}--> in stored/returned template HTML; comment form is acceptable only if renderer replacement is guaranteed.
After backend fix, retest rendered template tbody rows in DocumentPrint and PDF/print outputs.

Auth playbook checks (bcrypt prefix, httpOnly cookies, credentials-CORS explicit origin, brute-force lockout, seed_admin update path) were NOT fully executed in this task scope and need dedicated auth regression run.
critical_code_review_comments: RCA: backend sanitizer is configured with strip_comments=True in routes_document_templates.py, which removes <!--{{ITEMS_ROWS}}--> and yields empty tbody in /use response.
printCurrent behavior is now correct: no page-level window.print(), iframe is appended and used for printing then cleaned up.
PDF path remains aligned to previewRef target (downloadCurrentPdf uses previewRef.current).

success_rate.frontend: 85% (print/PDF/template render flow validated except backend-driven tbody row injection)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary blocker remains backend /use placeholder loss. UI confirms print button click appends iframe and avoids page window.print. Template registry still returns exactly one template id primary-mobile-a4-invoice-v1.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/document-templates/primary-mobile-a4-invoice-v1/use, inspect table body section -> <tbody></tbody> with no ITEMS_ROWS token. Root cause is consistent with comment stripping in sanitizer (`strip_comments=True`) while template relies on comment placeholder (`<!--{{ITEMS_ROWS}}-->`). Mitigation: preserve this placeholder in sanitize/store/resolve path or switch to non-comment token that survives sanitization and is replaced by renderer.
